# ghost/calendar

Fossify Calendar (local, no account): create an event, list upcoming events, read one event's details.

Deterministic phone automation for the Ghost in the Droid engine. Replays at zero LLM tokens.

## Install

```bash
ghost skill install ghost/calendar
```

## Run

```bash
ghost skill run ghost/calendar create_event --device <serial> --param title=<title> --param date=<date> --param start_time=<start_time>
ghost skill run ghost/calendar list_events --device <serial>
ghost skill run ghost/calendar get_event --device <serial> --param title=<title>
```

## Actions

- `create_event`: Add a dentist appointment tomorrow at 3pm for an hour
- `list_events`: What's on my calendar this week?
- `get_event`: When is my dentist visit?
